name: Gérce (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and yellow at the fly, charged at the centre of the blue with the municipal arms of Gérce (a crowned blue shield with two yellow lions, within a green wreath) above the name GÉRCE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gérce arms with crown and wreath
